menu_options.pick: Choose a battery that is in range

pick.description: These Tempra batteries are advertising right now.

manual.description: Enter the battery's Bluetooth address, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Use this when the battery is not advertising right now — for example because the Dometic app is connected to it, which occupies its only connection slot.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the battery's advertised name, such as KAA_502048_TLB150.

confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

reconfigure.description: Change the Bluetooth address of {name}. Entities and history are kept — use this after replacing a battery or correcting a typo.

error.invalid_address: Not a valid Bluetooth address. Expected six hex pairs, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.already_configured: Another battery is already configured with this address

init.description: Advanced settings. Only change the handshake token if a Bluetooth capture shows a different value.
